seo_description: Disco-funk score for a graduation animation film. Original composer dropped out a week before deadline. I wrote everything from scratch in 8 days.
hero.title: Ray Animation
hero.subtitle: Music Composition / Disco-Funk Score / DAE Howest Graduation Film
about.text: Disco-funk score for an animated film about a stone giant who wakes up in a cave and discovers dance. The original composer dropped out a week before the deadline. I stepped in, got the animatics, hand-placed sync markers, and matched every beat frame by frame. Three rounds of feedback. Standing ovation at the cinema screening.
music.m1.title: Bass & Rhythm
music.m1.desc: Slap bass and electric drums, Chic and Earth Wind & Fire style. Every hit matched to Ray's movements.
music.m2.title: Brass, Sax & Synths
music.m2.desc: Brass carries the melody. Saxophones add warmth. DJ scratches connect sections.
music.m3.title: Credits Version
music.m3.desc: Same theme, fuller. Gospel organs, live drums, Omnisphere synths. Approved first try.
